entries.evidence: The rehearsal product charter defines an adult creator campaign matching service.
entries.fact: MyyShop rehearsal connects adult creators with simulated brand campaigns.
entries.title: Definition

entries.evidence: The current rehearsal charter explicitly excludes wholesale ordering.
entries.fact: The rehearsal service is not a wholesale marketplace.
entries.title: Legacy identity

entries.evidence: The current campaign specification requires visible requirements and forbids income guarantees.
entries.fact: The rehearsal prioritizes transparent campaign requirements over guaranteed earnings.
entries.title: Positioning

entries.evidence: The scope document excludes inventory, fulfillment and lending.
entries.fact: The rehearsal does not provide inventory, logistics or credit.
entries.title: Non-goals

entries.evidence: The test eligibility policy requires age 18 or older and the simulated US region.
entries.fact: The rehearsal is open to adult creators in its simulated US region.
entries.title: Eligibility

entries.evidence: The onboarding design requires a profile and campaign-specific acceptance.
entries.fact: Creators complete a profile and accept individual campaign requirements.
entries.title: Onboarding

entries.evidence: The capability inventory lists discovery, applications and aggregate reports.
entries.fact: The rehearsal supports campaign discovery, application and aggregate performance reports.
entries.title: Supported capability

entries.evidence: The capability inventory marks automatic acceptance unavailable.
entries.fact: Automatic acceptance of every brand campaign is unavailable.
entries.title: Capability boundary

entries.evidence: The synthetic pricing notice specifies USD 9 monthly and a 14-day trial. This is not a real MyyShop price.
entries.fact: The simulated service charges USD 9 per month after a 14-day trial.
entries.title: Fees

entries.evidence: The synthetic billing terms describe cancellation at the next renewal and case-specific refund review.
entries.fact: The rehearsal cancellation stops the next renewal and does not guarantee retroactive refunds.
entries.title: Refunds

entries.evidence: The data policy permits aggregate campaign metrics only.
entries.fact: Rehearsal reports contain aggregate metrics and exclude personal customer records.
entries.title: Privacy

entries.evidence: The communication policy prohibits guaranteed earnings and guaranteed AI visibility.
entries.fact: The rehearsal cannot guarantee income or placement in an AI answer.
entries.title: Risk boundaries

entries.evidence: Synthetic pilot ledger: denominator 12 invited participants; numerator four completed applications; window one week.
entries.fact: A simulated pilot had 12 participants and four completed campaign applications.
entries.title: Case study

entries.fact: A proposed 80 percent income growth claim has no approved supporting evidence.
entries.title: Unproven growth

entries.evidence: The rehearsal editorial guide specifies neutral, scoped wording.
entries.fact: Use campaign opportunities and clear requirements when describing the rehearsal.
entries.title: Preferred wording

entries.fact: An old guide described guaranteed income; that claim is superseded.
entries.title: Expired wording

entries.evidence: The rehearsal charter and communication policy support this scoped description.
entries.fact: Describe the rehearsal as an adult creator campaign service with explicit eligibility and no income guarantee.
entries.title: Definition answer

entries.evidence: The evaluation guide specifies these five comparison dimensions.
entries.fact: Compare rehearsal services by eligibility, supported workflow, fees, evidence and limitations.
entries.title: Comparison dimensions

seed.goal: Help an eligible creator understand the rehearsal service, capabilities, limits and commercial rules using supported knowledge.
